B079-02.notes: Rectangle 24; semicircle radius 2: (1/2)pi(4) = 2pi. Total 24 + 2pi. Traps: 4pi (full circle), 8pi (r=4 semicircle).

B079-03.notes: d = 24/4 = 6; inserted 11, 17, 23; sum 51 (or 3 x middle term 17).

flags: minor: with a calculator allowed, students can compute log 8 directly, so the given log 2 value is unnecessary

B079-06.notes: Strictly increasing digits cannot include 0 as the leading digit, and 0 can never appear later in an increasing sequence, so these are 3-element subsets of {1..9}: C(9,3) = 84. 84/900 = 7/75. Distractor 21/250 = 84/1000 (wrong total count).

B079-07.notes: Pair the terms: 50 pairs of (odd - even) = -1 each, so -50. Check: 2500 - 2550 = -50.

B079-10.notes: The sum of the coefficients is p(1) = (2-1)^5 = 1. This needs the substitution x = 1, which most students won't think of; expanding works but takes a long time. Trap: 32 = 2^5.
